correctness.rationale: Independent standard-library replay reconstructed the LCF graph, 42 perfect matchings, and all 35,368 ordinary matchings; 15,820 extendible faces including the empty face, with the stated f-vector. The 7,901 matched pairs are disjoint covers and the complete 78,921-incidence digraph is acyclic. On the critical cells (1 in dimension 0, 5 in dimension 2, 10 in dimension 3, 1 in dimension 4), signed integral reduction reproduced both matrices, including determinant −1 on columns 0,1,2,4,8 of the degree-three differential and the identically zero degree-four differential. The three-skeleton is simply connected and has H2=0, hence is 2-connected and is equivalent to a wedge of five 3-spheres by Hurewicz and homological Whitehead. The degree-four attaching sphere has zero class in H3 of that skeleton and hence in π3, adding an S4 summand. Reproduce with python3 /workspace/branches/00f8fa2a-732d-417f-be3f-48aceb015c98/audit_pappus.py; the finite script does not prove the general homotopy theorems or establish originality.
